definition: where my attention goes, what holds it, and what it does when I leave it alone

settled:
What good regulation buys me is attention. When the traffic is moving, what clears is attention I can then spend, and how much of it I have available is the core of the whole thing.

The total swings by orders of magnitude with how regulated I am, so the same room can be unbearable on one day and empty on another.

The focus and diffuse pair I run all of this on is Barbara Oakley's rather than mine.

I use the same two modes at both ends of a night. Letting a focus give out is how I go under. The diffuse channel handing me a finished idea is how I come back up. One zone, entered and left.
